rationale: Target-seeking reactive command q = (target_voltage_pu - base_voltage_pu)/q_sensitivity_pu_per_kvar per bus. Aggregate EV inverter capability at bus = sum sqrt(s_rating_kva^2 - active_power_kw^2). bus_2: need 0.036/0.0016 = 22.5 kvar, capability sqrt(18^2-10^2)+sqrt(12^2-6^2)=14.9666+10.3923=25.3589, so unclipped 22.5. bus_3: need 0.028/0.0012 = 23.3333 kvar, capability sqrt(16^2-8^2)=13.8564, clipped to 13.8564. Corrected voltages from base + sensitivity*q.
